principle: A grade-banded learning-tool-language surface token is not guaranteed to denote one globally fixed dictionary lexeme.

RESOLVED_LEXEME_BINDING.scope: contextual, not global unless source explicitly disambiguates

rules: Do not force a one-to-one global TOOL_TOKEN to NIKL lexeme mapping for bare ambiguous surface forms.
Grade compatibility is candidate pruning only, never semantic confirmation.
Explicit homonym suffixes such as 01/03 may bind directly when they match NIKL standard_homonym_no.
Parenthetical usage/collocation may bind only when candidate meanings exclude alternatives.
Bare ambiguous tokens preserve all plausible lexeme candidates until actual learning/standard context is available.
NIKL-unmatched multiword classroom/tool expressions remain first-class TOOL_TOKEN nodes and are not deleted.
LEXICAL_PREREQUISITE edges attach to a resolved lexeme or explicit phrase-in-context, never blindly to an ambiguous surface string.

counterexample_notes.observation: curriculum prose uses 시각적인 단서, while NIKL also has 時刻/視角/視覺 candidates; grade alone can select the wrong sense
curriculum prose uses 고려하여 (=考慮), while grade pruning can leave 高麗
교육과정 context requires 課程 while other contexts can use 過程
기술하기 in language-function context denotes 記述, distinct from 技術
surface occurrence in 보고 따라 is a connective/verb-derived form, showing surface matching alone is unsafe
